# Synthetic STEP fixture

`box-10x20x30mm.step` is an original rectangular 10 × 20 × 30 mm box generated by `scripts/generate-step-fixture.mjs` using the installed occt-wasm 4.3.1 kernel. No third-party design or user data is included. The fixture verifies the actual STEP Worker, OpenCascade WASM loading, tessellation and project reconstruction.
